title: Claim registry row
description: One row of governance/CLAIM_REGISTRY.csv. The interpretation layer of the 3-layer spine: claims + controlled status. Columns are in CSV order.

claim.description: The claim, stated as a falsifiable assertion.

status.description: Controlled status vocabulary (7 values); never 'confirmed by repetition'.

best_evidence.description: Strongest evidence FOR the claim. May be empty for Untested decisions.

counterevidence.description: Caveats or evidence against. May be empty.

assumptions.description: The load-bearing assumption the status depends on.

falsifier_or_decision_experiment.description: What measurement would falsify the claim, or the decision experiment that resolves it.

superseded_claims.description: Space- or semicolon-separated claim_ids this claim supersedes. May be empty.

epoch.description: Evidence epoch id(s) from EVIDENCE_EPOCHS.md (e.g. E6-clean-ruler, 'spans', or 'old=E3..., clean=E6...').

evidence_files_or_run_ids.description: results.csv exp_id(s) and/or clean_eval / governance paths backing the claim.
